sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent infrastructure dominates today's list: frameworks, computer-use tooling, agent memory, and secure agent workspaces occupy the top tier. The list also shows strong practical demand for open finance, offline knowledge, media automation, and security tooling.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent application infrastructure; local and offline computing; practical AI applications in finance and media. Language tally: Rust 3, TypeScript 3, Python 3, Go 1, HTML 1, and one unavailable.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The daily list is less about standalone model releases and more about the operational layer around agents: computer-use fleets, memory, secure workspaces, configuration, and application frameworks.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's strongest GitHub signal is the maturation of agentic software into a product and infrastructure ecosystem. Developers are building execution, memory, security, configuration, and domain applications around agents.
